Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: After Seconds game environment architectural cutaway reference board, version V0.01. Create an exceptionally detailed, legible, 3D architectural bird's-eye dollhouse rendering of ONE underground level, NOT stacked floors. Wide landscape presentation. Reference image is the governing topological floor plan, not a style image. Preserve room IDs and relative placement, tunnel connections and separate rooms. All underground halls have CIRCULAR footprints inside true hemispherical structural shells excavated into rock. Cut away roofs/front shell surfaces, retain rear curved shell/ribs and partial transparent dome outlines, expose the entire floor with recognizable furniture. Corridors are narrow vaulted tunnels through rock, not open bridges. There must be rock gaps between distinct circular halls, not one rectangular building or giant dome. Main full-floor model occupies upper 65% with a clear readable label beside each room. Lower 35% has THREE large close-up isometric interior insets, showing furniture arrangements, work surfaces and mundane props. No gore, prisoners, weapons demonstrations, or extra supernatural powers. No people required. Furniture is used but organized, grounded, realistic human scale. Architectural illustration must be bright enough to read details even for dark gameplay areas. No narrative arrows, puzzle-solution signs or invented construction dimensions. Title exactly 'AFTER SECONDS · B5 · V0.01'. Room labels short IDs only; inset titles in simple Korean. Small footer '실내 배치 시각화 · 정확한 좌표는 배치도 기준'. This is concept rendering, not a photoreal exterior.
B5 clinical isolation living floor: pale blue white concrete, cool restrained white lighting. Match the plan's TWELVE caverns plus VA VB VL vertical cores. C01 player containment round hall includes a large transparent observation pod in middle, personal bed, bedding, desk, sink, toilet with privacy divider and storage along perimeter. C02 guard monitoring hall with desk, two screens, keyboard, computer tower, headset and incident files. C03 cooling tanks/pumps. C04 utilities. West W01 and W02: 4 individual living modules each arranged inside each circular hall, doors opening to unobstructed shared circulation; a single narrow bed, pillow blanket, small table, sink, privacy-enclosed toilet, towel, soap, tissue, folded clothing, slippers, personal shelf and meal hatch in each module. W03 examination/recovery beds, diagnostic carts and screens. E01 clean linen/clothes shelving separate from used-linen carts. E02 meal preparation, fridge, serving counter, trays and dishwashing sink. E03 wash/decontamination shower area. N01 central observation multi-monitor workstations. S01 closed test chamber with covered idle equipment.
Insets: 1 W01 '격리 생활' show the FOUR personal modules and their living props clearly; 2 C02 '관찰 데스크' show two guard desks with screens, chairs, radios, clipboard, coffee, cables; 3 E02 '배식과 회수' show serving/dishwashing and trolley layout. No gratuitous brutality.

B4 observation and ability-measurement research floor, charcoal gray and graphite interiors, neutral white task lights, restrained screens. Thirteen circular caverns plus VA VB VL. Central C01 observation test hall, partial crescent observation deck around north half +2.5m inside this one dome, two stairs; instrumented floor with camera positions, consoles on the partial deck. C02 diagnostic beds; C03 equipment support; C04 analysis desks; C05 records cabinets. W01 throw-delay measurement: target rail, timestamp display, safe testing objects, camera tripods, floor distance marks and operator desk; no moving supernatural effects. B3 sample archive, data analysis and primary server floor. Thirteen separate circular caverns plus three cores, as reference. Cold desaturated steel blue-gray, dormant storage banks are dim with minimal access strip lighting; active examination benches have local light, server rack status LEDs restrained. Exposure lifted for a legible illustration. C01 central specimen racks with sealed labeled cases and a clear main aisle; C02 cold storage, C03 sealed waste/recovery, C04 decontamination, C05 preparation bench. W01 raw sample racks, W02 long-term freezer banks, W03 sealed waste holding carts. E01 biosignal data analysis desks. E02 PRIMARY SERVER ROOM with EIGHT server racks in TWO ROWS facing service aisles, visible patch panels, rack servers, storage arrays, cable trays, network switches, UPS separated at perimeter, dedicated cooling units, maintenance desk. E03 consumable stock shelves gloves tubes bins and cartons. N01 specimen receiving/checking counter. S01 wash and sterilization with distinct dirty return and clean holding positions. NO residential bedrooms on this floor. Existing plan organization, not an added medical procedure.
Insets: E02 '주 서버실' detailed two rows of racks with hot/cold service aisles and cabling; C01 '시료 보관' shelves/cases/carts and unobstructed aisles; C05 '시료 준비와 기록' benches with tubes pipettes gloves bottles label printer computer notebook and waste bins.

B2 mechanical utilities floor. Twelve independent circular caverns plus three cores. Dark steel surfaces with subtle worn paint, RED continuous auxiliary lamps plus NEUTRAL task lights on stairs/valves, not an active alarm or fiery scene. C01 centrifugal machinery. C02 cooling/pump hall MUST feature a U-shaped steel GRATING MEZZANINE at +3.6m on north/west/east perimeter, OPEN CENTER, TWO spaced staircases on west/east running from south floor to side deck, railings, visible support columns/beams/connections. Two tanks below center and two pumps south, connected pipes. Mezzanine provides sight down through grating, with small opaque steel work pads behind equipment. Upper deck does not create a second underground story. C03 distribution cabinets; C04 control desks. W01 main generators/switchgear; W02 standby power; W03 maintenance tool benches/parts bins. E01 water pumps; E02 air filters; E03 wastewater holding equipment; N01 main ventilation machinery; S01 maintenance oversight desks. Useful oil rag, tools, spare valves, meters, hose reels, carts, lockers and wash sink in work areas. No bedrooms.
Insets: C02 '그레이팅 메자닌' high cutaway showing BOTH stairs, open center, support beams and tanks BELOW; W03 '정비 작업대' tools/spares/cart/logs; C04 '설비 관제' desks with monitors controls records mugs and radios. Ensure C02 is a circular cavern, not a rectangular warehouse.
